title: Will Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) surpass human capabilities by 2029?
summary: Based on current hardware scaling rates, autonomous agent frameworks, and machine learning breakthroughs, expert networks project a high probability of achieving AGI.

title: Will a consumer home humanoid robot retail for under $5,000 by 2030?
summary: Robotic hardware manufacturing is scaling fast, but reaching a sub-$5,000 price point for a fully autonomous household utility remains a significant engineering hurdle.

title: Will Nvidia's market cap exceed Apple and Microsoft combined before 2030?

title: Will global inflation sustainably drop below 2% across developed economies over the next 12 months?
summary: Analysis of central bank monetary tightening, energy stabilization, and supply chain normalization points toward moderate price stabilization.

title: Will at least one G7 nation launch a retail Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)?
summary: Leading central banks are intensifying pilot programs for digital fiat to secure payment rails and counter private stablecoin dominance.

title: Will a new major economy formally join the BRICS bloc next year?
summary: Geopolitical realignment continues to drive developing nations toward alternative economic blocs, with multiple formal applications pending.

title: Will the first commercial unmanned spacecraft successfully land on Mars by 2028?

title: Will streaming platforms capture over 70% of traditional linear TV advertising revenue?
